act_title: The Prohibition of Benami Property Transactions Act, 1988
title: Previous sanction
text:
55. Previous sanction.—No prosecution shall be instituted against any person in respect of any

offence under sections 3, 53 or section 54 without the previous sanction of the [competent authority].]
